turns.q: Is there anything I should pair it with to get the best result?
turns.replyTail: I’d pair the cooler with YETI ICE®: - Pre-chill the cooler with sacrificial ice before packing it. - Use roughly two-thirds ice to one-third food, drinks, or bait. - Line the bottom with YETI ICE® and fill empty space with ice or towels. - For easier organisation, a compatible dry basket or divider can keep food and drinks separated from the ice. The recommended amount of YETI ICE® depends on the cooler size, so the exact pairing will be more specific once I know which model you’re considering.
